title: Lauren Library Item
description: Manifest for one effect, transition or animation. The AI receives a catalog built from these manifests and picks items by id; nothing about individual items is hardcoded in the edit plan schema or the app.

description.description: What it looks like and when to use it. Written for the AI: this is how it chooses.

tags.description: Mood and style hints, e.g. energetic, smooth, comedic, cinematic.

overlap.description: Transitions only. true: both clips are visible at once, so they overlap by the duration and the timeline gets shorter. false: applied to the end of the previous clip and the start of the next, timeline length unchanged.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema (type object) for the item's parameters. Every parameter needs a default and a description so the AI can use it.

render.description: How the engine draws the item. Format not decided yet (see docs/LIBRARY.md).
